terrain.source: NASA LRO LOLA GDR polar DEMs (PDS, imbrium.mit.edu)
files: NASA PGDA shape-from-shading model, 5 m/px (LROC NAC photographs on LOLA; Bertone et al. 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17954508), +-7.5 km around the site
terrain.note_5m: SfS model: terrain detail from LROC NAC photographs where the ground is sunlit in them; LOLA elsewhere

ephemeris.observer: site on the Moon (coord@301, geodetic, MEAN_ME), airless
ephemeris.quantities: apparent azimuth/elevation (az from north toward east), angular diameter

meta.method: One light: the Sun at its JPL Horizons direction and true angular size. All other light is reflected by the terrain (path tracing, 5 diffuse bounces).
meta.limits: terrain within 60 km only (LOLA every 160 m beyond 8 km); rough diffuse regolith (Oren-Nayar), not a Hapke model; Earth image NASA Blue Marble 2002, orientation approximate; SIMULATED
meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (AI) during the event; no generative image model.
